description: The chart represents the distribution of different stimulus types, showing the proportion of each category. The chart is divided into nine slices, each representing a distinct stimulus type. The slices are labeled with their corresponding categories and percentages, and are colored differently, although the exact shades are not distinguishable. The categories and their approximate percentages are: Draft/Other (26.4%, red), Event Posting (6.6%, pink), Organizational Report (7.7%, purple), Organizational Website (4.9%, light purple), Interview (8.8%, blue), Intra-agency news article (4.9%, dark blue), External News Article (18.1%, green), Email (2.7%, light green), Press Release (18.7%, yellow), and Social Media Post (1.1%, orange). The chart does not include a legend, but the labels are placed outside the circle, adjacent to their corresponding slices, and the percentages are displayed alongside the labels. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice, Draft/Other, starting at the top right.
